examples: Before the trip, we need to allocate a budget for each day.
قبل از سفر، باید بودجه‌ای برای هر روز اختصاص دهیم.
Our manager allocated three members to the new project this morning.
مدیر ما امروز صبح سه نفر را به پروژه جدید اختصاص داد.

معلم از ما خواست ده دقیقه را به هر تمرین اختصاص دهیم.
miniContext: When Sara planned her monthly budget, she had to **allocate** money carefully between rent, groceries, and savings. She started by listing her fixed expenses, then decided how much she could set aside each week. A sudden car repair forced her to allocate less to entertainment that month. By tracking where every dollar went, she learned to allocate her income more wisely over time.

examples: If the flight is cancelled, we need an alternative plan.
اگر پرواز لغو شود، به یک برنامه جایگزین نیاز داریم.
Cycling to work is a healthy alternative to driving.
دوچرخه‌سواری به سر کار یک جایگزین سالم برای رانندگی است.
She looked for an alternative after the restaurant was fully booked.
او بعد از اینکه رستوران کاملاً رزرو شده بود، به دنبال جایگزین دیگری گشت.
miniContext: When the usual bus route was closed for repairs, commuters had to find an **alternative** way to reach downtown. Some chose to carpool, while others tried the subway for the first time. A few discovered that cycling was actually faster than the bus had been. By the time the repairs finished, many people had grown used to their alternative and kept using it.

examples: The company holds an annual meeting every January.
شرکت هر ساله در ماه ژانویه یک جلسه سالانه برگزار می‌کند.
Our family takes an annual trip to the mountains in summer.
خانواده ما هر سال در تابستان یک سفر سالانه به کوهستان می‌رود.

گزارش سالانه موزه نشان داد که تعداد بازدیدکنندگان افزایش یافته است.
miniContext: Every December, the company reviews its performance in an **annual** report that summarizes sales, costs, and new projects from the past year. Managers use this annual review to plan budgets for the next twelve months. Employees also receive an annual bonus based on how well the team performed. For many staff members, the annual report is the clearest picture they get of how the whole business is doing.

examples: It became apparent that the plan would not work.
آشکار شد که این برنامه کار نخواهد کرد.
There was no apparent reason for the sudden delay.
هیچ دلیل آشکاری برای تأخیر ناگهانی وجود نداشت.
Her nervousness was apparent to everyone in the room.
عصبی بودن او برای همه افراد در اتاق آشکار بود.
miniContext: As soon as the results came in, it was **apparent** that something had gone wrong with the experiment. The apparent problem was a faulty sensor that had been giving incorrect readings for days. Once the team replaced it, the data made sense again. The lesson was clear: an apparent mistake is often just a sign that something deeper needs checking.

examples: Problems can arise when teams don't communicate clearly.
وقتی تیم‌ها به‌طور واضح ارتباط برقرار نمی‌کنند، مشکلاتی ممکن است به وجود بیاید.
A new opportunity arose after the company expanded overseas.
پس از اینکه شرکت در خارج از کشور گسترش یافت، فرصت جدیدی به وجود آمد.
Questions will arise once the new policy is announced.
به محض اعلام سیاست جدید، سؤالاتی به وجود خواهد آمد.
miniContext: Whenever a big project starts, unexpected issues can **arise** at almost any stage. On this project, a shortage of materials arose just two weeks before the deadline, forcing the team to find a new supplier overnight. Such problems rarely arise without warning signs beforehand, but they are easy to miss when everyone is busy. This is why experienced managers build extra time into their schedule for issues that arise.

examples: Safety is an important aspect of the job.
ایمنی یک جنبه مهم از این شغل است.
The report covers every aspect of the company's finances.
این گزارش هر جنبه‌ای از امور مالی شرکت را پوشش می‌دهد.
She enjoys the creative aspect of her work more than the paperwork.
او جنبه خلاقانه کارش را بیشتر از کارهای اداری دوست دارد.
miniContext: A good teacher pays attention to every **aspect** of a student's progress, not just test scores. One important aspect is how confident a student feels when speaking in class. Another aspect is whether they enjoy the subject at all. By looking at each aspect together, teachers can understand a student's growth far better than grades alone could show.

examples: We made an assumption that the store would be open.
ما این فرض را کردیم که مغازه باز خواهد بود.
His whole argument rests on a questionable assumption.
کل استدلال او بر یک فرض مشکوک استوار است.
The planners based their budget on an assumption that prices would stay stable.
برنامه‌ریزان بودجه خود را بر این فرض بنا کردند که قیمت‌ها ثابت خواهند ماند.
miniContext: Before building their business plan, the founders wrote down every **assumption** they were making, from customer demand to shipping costs. One key assumption was that most orders would come from local customers. When sales from other cities turned out to be much higher, they realized that assumption had been wrong. Testing an assumption early, they learned, is far cheaper than discovering it was false after launch.

examples: They will attempt to fix the leak themselves before calling a plumber.
آنها قبل از تماس با لوله‌کش، تلاش خواهند کرد خودشان نشتی را درست کنند.
She attempted the exam again after failing it last year.
او بعد از رد شدن در سال گذشته، دوباره برای این آزمون تلاش کرد.
We should attempt a different approach if this one keeps failing.
اگر این روش همچنان شکست بخورد، باید رویکرد دیگری را تلاش کنیم.
miniContext: After the first climb failed, the team decided to **attempt** the summit again the following spring. This time they attempted a different route, hoping to avoid the storms that had stopped them before. Even with better planning, no one could guarantee that the attempt would succeed. Still, they knew that refusing to attempt it again would guarantee they never reached the top.

examples: The stadium has a seating capacity of fifty thousand.
این استادیوم ظرفیت نشستن پنجاه هزار نفر را دارد.
Our server reached full capacity during the sale.
سرور ما در طول حراج به ظرفیت کامل خود رسید.
The new factory doubled the company's production capacity.
کارخانه جدید ظرفیت تولید شرکت را دو برابر کرد.
miniContext: When ticket sales opened for the concert, the venue quickly reached its full **capacity** of ten thousand seats. Organizers had planned for this capacity months in advance, arranging extra parking and security. Even so, demand far exceeded the hall's capacity, leaving thousands of fans without tickets. Next year, they are considering a larger venue with almost double the capacity.

examples: Under no circumstance should you share your password.
تحت هیچ شرایطی نباید رمز عبورت را با کسی به اشتراک بگذاری.
Given the circumstances, canceling the trip seemed like the right choice.
با توجه به شرایط، لغو سفر انتخاب درستی به نظر می‌رسید.
He only lied because of an unusual circumstance, not out of habit.
او فقط به خاطر یک شرایط غیرعادی دروغ گفت، نه از روی عادت.
miniContext: Every family faces a difficult **circumstance** at some point, whether it is illness, job loss, or an unexpected move. In Maria's case, the circumstance was her father's sudden surgery, which meant she had to take time off work. Friends and neighbors stepped in to help with meals and childcare during that circumstance. Looking back, she says that hard circumstance taught her who she could really count on.

examples: I sent an email asking for clarification on the deadline.
من ایمیلی فرستادم و درباره مهلت زمانی درخواست شفاف‌سازی کردم.
The teacher offered clarification after several students looked confused.
معلم پس از اینکه چند دانش‌آموز گیج به نظر می‌رسیدند، شفاف‌سازی کرد.
Could you give me some clarification about how the refund works?
می‌شود درباره نحوه کار بازپرداخت کمی برای من شفاف‌سازی کنید؟
miniContext: During the meeting, one client raised her hand and asked for **clarification** about the new pricing plan. The sales manager paused and offered a clearer clarification, breaking the numbers down step by step. Without that clarification, several clients might have signed up for the wrong package. Afterward, the company added a short video explaining the pricing, so fewer customers would need clarification in the future.

examples: Every decision has a consequence, good or bad.
هر تصمیمی پیامدی دارد، خوب یا بد.
Missing the deadline had a serious consequence for the whole team.
از دست دادن مهلت زمانی پیامد جدی‌ای برای کل تیم داشت.
She accepted the consequence of her mistake without complaining.
او پیامد اشتباه خودش را بدون شکایت پذیرفت.
miniContext: Skipping sleep before an important exam can have a real **consequence** on performance, even for strong students. One common consequence is difficulty concentrating during the test itself. A less obvious consequence is feeling irritable and stressed for days afterward. Understanding these effects helps students see that a single consequence, like one bad night's sleep, can shape far more than just one morning.

examples: The storm caused considerable damage to the coastal town.
طوفان خسارت قابل توجهی به شهر ساحلی وارد کرد.
She spent a considerable amount of time preparing for the interview.
او زمان قابل توجهی را برای آماده شدن برای مصاحبه صرف کرد.
There is considerable disagreement among scientists about the cause.
میان دانشمندان درباره علت این موضوع اختلاف نظر قابل توجهی وجود دارد.
miniContext: Switching to solar panels required a **considerable** investment up front, more than the family had first expected. Even so, the considerable savings on their electricity bill paid off the cost within a few years. Neighbors noticed the change and grew curious once they saw the results for themselves. Within two years, a considerable number of houses on the street had installed panels of their own.

examples: Adults should not consume more than the recommended amount of sugar.
بزرگسالان نباید بیش از میزان توصیه‌شده قند مصرف کنند.
The old refrigerator consumed far more electricity than the new model.
یخچال قدیمی برق بسیار بیشتری نسبت به مدل جدید مصرف می‌کرد.
We need to consume less plastic packaging to reduce waste.
باید بسته‌بندی پلاستیکی کمتری مصرف کنیم تا زباله کمتری تولید شود.
miniContext: Nutritionists often remind people not to **consume** too much processed food, even when it tastes good. A typical fast-food meal can consume nearly a whole day's recommended calories in one sitting. Over time, habits like this can consume more than just calories; they can affect energy and mood as well. Small changes, like cooking at home more often, help people consume a healthier balance of nutrients.

examples: Everyone on the team should contribute ideas during the brainstorm.
همه اعضای تیم باید در طول جلسه ایده‌پردازی، ایده‌هایی مشارکت کنند.
Poor sleep contributed to her difficulty concentrating at work.
خواب نامناسب در مشکل تمرکز او در محل کار نقش داشت.
Each employee is asked to contribute five percent of their salary to the pension fund.
از هر کارمند خواسته می‌شود پنج درصد از حقوق خود را به صندوق بازنشستگی مشارکت کند.
miniContext: Scientists believe that several factors **contribute** to climate change, not just one single cause. Burning fossil fuels contributes the largest share, but deforestation and farming also play a role. Even small daily choices, like driving instead of walking, contribute to the overall picture. Understanding how each factor contributes separately helps policymakers decide where to focus their efforts first.

examples: The volunteers need to coordinate their schedules before the event.
داوطلبان باید قبل از برنامه، زمان‌بندی خودشان را هماهنگ کنند.
She coordinated the entire wedding without hiring a planner.
او کل عروسی را بدون استخدام یک برنامه‌ریز هماهنگ کرد.

لطفاً قبل از ارسال سفارش، با انبار هماهنگ کنید.
miniContext: Running a music festival means you have to **coordinate** dozens of moving parts at once, from stage setup to parking. The organizers coordinate closely with local police to manage traffic on the busiest night. Volunteers also coordinate among themselves using a shared schedule app. Without someone to coordinate all these details, even a small mistake could delay the whole event.

examples: Getting enough sleep is crucial before a big exam.
خواب کافی قبل از یک امتحان مهم بسیار حیاتی است.
Clear communication was crucial during the emergency landing.
ارتباط واضح در طول فرود اضطراری بسیار حیاتی بود.
The first few seconds of a job interview are crucial.
چند ثانیه اول مصاحبه شغلی بسیار حیاتی هستند.
miniContext: In any surgery, timing is **crucial**, and even a short delay can change the outcome. The surgeon explained that the first hour after the injury was especially crucial for the patient's recovery. Nurses played a crucial role too, monitoring vital signs every few minutes. Looking back, the family agreed that the crucial decision to call an ambulance immediately had saved his life.

examples: Despite the rain, the match continued without delay.
با وجود باران، بازی بدون تأخیر ادامه یافت.

Despite his doubts, he agreed to join the new project.
با وجود شک‌هایش، او پذیرفت که به پروژه جدید ملحق شود.
miniContext: Despite growing up in a small village with no theater nearby, Hana became one of the country's most celebrated actors. Despite early rejections from several drama schools, she kept auditioning until one finally accepted her. Her teachers often said that despite her quiet nature, she transformed completely on stage. Her story reminds young performers that talent can grow despite a difficult start.

examples: The smoke alarm can detect even a small amount of smoke.
آلارم دود می‌تواند حتی مقدار کمی از دود را تشخیص دهد.
Doctors detected the illness early thanks to a routine checkup.
پزشکان به لطف یک معاینه معمول، بیماری را زود تشخیص دادند.
This software can detect unusual activity on your bank account.
این نرم‌افزار می‌تواند فعالیت غیرعادی در حساب بانکی شما را تشخیص دهد.
miniContext: Modern telescopes can **detect** light from stars that died billions of years ago. Astronomers detect these faint signals using instruments far more sensitive than the human eye. Even a tiny change in brightness can detect the presence of a planet orbiting a distant star. As technology improves, scientists expect to detect even smaller and more distant objects in the coming years.

examples: The committee will determine the winner by Friday.

miniContext: Before approving a loan, the bank must **determine** whether the applicant can realistically repay it. Several factors determine this decision, including income, debt, and credit history. A single late payment years ago might not determine the outcome on its own. In the end, it is the whole financial picture that helps the bank determine a fair answer.

examples: The city has a diverse population from many countries.

A diverse team often comes up with more creative solutions.
یک تیم متنوع اغلب راه‌حل‌های خلاقانه‌تری ارائه می‌دهد.
miniContext: The new restaurant offers a **diverse** menu, with dishes inspired by Thai, Mexican, and Italian cooking. The owner wanted a genuinely diverse kitchen staff too, hiring chefs who had trained in each of those countries. Customers often say the diverse flavors are what keep them coming back. For a small neighborhood spot, it has built a surprisingly diverse and loyal following.

examples: This app will enable you to track your spending easily.

سطح شیب‌دار جدید به کاربران ویلچر امکان ورود به ساختمان را داد.
Better internet access can enable students in rural areas to take online classes.
دسترسی بهتر به اینترنت می‌تواند به دانش‌آموزان مناطق روستایی امکان شرکت در کلاس‌های آنلاین را بدهد.
miniContext: A simple change in the factory layout was enough to **enable** workers to finish tasks much faster. New machines enabled the team to produce twice as many units per shift. Better training also enabled staff to fix small problems themselves instead of waiting for a technician. Together, these changes enable the factory to meet demand without hiring many new employees.

examples: Hikers may encounter wildlife on this trail, so stay alert.
کوهنوردان ممکن است در این مسیر با حیات وحش مواجه شوند، پس هوشیار باشید.

او هنگام راه‌اندازی نرم‌افزار جدید با چند مشکل مواجه شد.

miniContext: During their trip across the desert, the explorers expected to **encounter** extreme heat but not much else. Instead, they encountered a sudden sandstorm that forced them to stop for two days. Later, they encountered a small village where locals offered them food and shelter. Every unexpected thing they encountered became part of the story they told for years afterward.

examples: One kilometer is roughly equivalent to 0.6 miles.

حقوق او معادل چیزی است که یک مدیر ارشد در جای دیگر دریافت می‌کند.

این دوره آنلاین واحدی معادل یک ترم کامل ارائه می‌دهد.
miniContext: When Leila moved abroad, she had to find a job **equivalent** to the one she held back home. Her new employer needed proof that her old degree was equivalent to a local qualification. After some paperwork, the university confirmed it was indeed equivalent. Her new salary ended up being roughly equivalent to her old one, once the cost of living was considered.

examples: The two companies want to establish a long-term partnership.
این دو شرکت می‌خواهند یک همکاری بلندمدت ایجاد کنند.

او طی سال‌های متمادی اعتبار خودش را به‌عنوان یک روزنامه‌نگار قابل اعتماد تثبیت کرد.
We should establish clear rules before the children start school.
باید قبل از شروع مدرسه بچه‌ها، قوانین واضحی ایجاد کنیم.
miniContext: It took years of hard work for the small bakery to **establish** itself as the best in town. The owners first had to establish trust with local suppliers who were used to working with bigger chains. Once they established a loyal customer base, word of mouth did the rest. Today, the bakery is so well established that people drive from other cities just to visit.

examples: Can you estimate how long the repair will take?
می‌توانی برآورد کنی تعمیر چقدر زمان می‌برد؟
The contractor estimated the cost at around five thousand dollars.
پیمانکار هزینه را حدود پنج هزار دلار برآورد کرد.
Experts estimate that the population will double within thirty years.
کارشناسان برآورد می‌کنند که جمعیت تا سی سال آینده دو برابر خواهد شد.
miniContext: Before starting any renovation, a good contractor will **estimate** both the time and the cost involved. In this case, the contractor estimated six weeks for the kitchen, though it ended up taking eight. Materials were also harder to estimate accurately, since prices kept changing during the project. Homeowners are often advised to estimate a bit higher than expected, just to be safe.

examples: Don't expose the photos to direct sunlight, or they will fade.

این تحقیق سال‌ها تقلب مالی در شرکت را آشکار کرد.

کار کردن در فضای باز می‌تواند شما را در معرض دماهای شدید قرار دهد.
miniContext: Years of investigative work finally helped reporters **expose** the company's hidden safety violations. Their report exposed documents that executives had tried to keep private for over a decade. Workers who had been afraid to speak up felt safer once the story exposed the full picture. After the scandal, new laws were passed to expose similar problems before they could cause harm.

examples: Solar panels generate electricity even on cloudy days.
پنل‌های خورشیدی حتی در روزهای ابری نیز برق ایجاد می‌کنند.
The announcement generated a lot of excitement among fans.
این اعلامیه هیجان زیادی در میان هواداران ایجاد کرد.
This report will generate a summary of last month's sales.

miniContext: A single viral video can **generate** millions of views within just a few days. In this case, the video generated so much attention that the small business behind it sold out of stock overnight. Comments and shares generated even more curiosity among people who hadn't seen it yet. The owners never expected one short clip to generate that kind of response.

examples: Some delays are inevitable when you work with old equipment.
برخی تأخیرها هنگام کار با تجهیزات قدیمی اجتناب‌ناپذیر هستند.
Change felt inevitable once the new management took over.
پس از به دست گرفتن مدیریت جدید، تغییر اجتناب‌ناپذیر به نظر می‌رسید.
An argument seemed inevitable the moment they started discussing money.
به محض اینکه آنها شروع به بحث درباره پول کردند، یک دعوا اجتناب‌ناپذیر به نظر می‌رسید.
miniContext: As the storm grew stronger, it became **inevitable** that the festival would have to be cancelled. Organizers had tried everything to avoid it, but the cancellation felt inevitable by Thursday morning. Ticket holders accepted the inevitable news better than expected, since refunds were processed quickly. Sometimes, admitting that an outcome is inevitable early on saves everyone a lot of stress.

examples: It's hard to justify the extra cost without seeing real results.
بدون دیدن نتایج واقعی، توجیه کردن هزینه اضافی سخت است.

او تصمیمش را با توضیح مزایای بلندمدت توجیه کرد.
You don't need to justify taking a break; everyone needs rest.
لازم نیست استراحت کردن را توجیه کنی؛ همه به استراحت نیاز دارند.
miniContext: Before buying the expensive camera, Omar tried to **justify** the purchase to himself. He justified it by pointing out how much he would save on renting equipment for his freelance work. His wife, however, wasn't convinced by that justification at first. Eventually, after seeing how often he used it for paid jobs, she agreed the expense was easy to justify.

examples: You can modify the recipe by using less sugar.
می‌توانی دستور پخت را با استفاده از قند کمتر تغییر دهی.
The team modified the design after customer feedback.
تیم پس از بازخورد مشتریان، طرح را تغییر داد.
We need to modify our schedule to fit the new deadline.
باید برنامه‌مان را برای هماهنگی با مهلت زمانی جدید تغییر دهیم.
miniContext: After the first test flight, engineers decided to **modify** the wing design slightly. They modified the shape to reduce drag, which improved fuel efficiency by a noticeable margin. A second round of testing led them to modify the tail as well. Each small change engineers made to modify the aircraft brought it closer to the final, approved model.

examples: You must obtain written permission before entering the site.
باید قبل از ورود به محل، اجازه کتبی به دست بیاوری.

miniContext: To open a small bakery, Fatima first had to **obtain** several permits from the city. It took weeks to obtain approval from the health department alone. miniContext: Power outages used to **occur** frequently in the old neighborhood, especially during summer storms. After the city upgraded the wiring, outages began to occur far less often. miniContext: When the scout first watched the teenager play, he immediately noticed her **potential**. Her potential was obvious in the way she read the game, even if her technique still needed work. miniContext: During the job interview, Daniel tried to mention only the experience that felt truly **relevant** to the position. He highlighted a relevant project from his last job that matched the company's needs closely. His focus on relevant details impressed the interviewers far more than a long list of unrelated skills would have.

miniContext: Few inventions **transform** daily life as much as the smartphone has. It didn't just transform how people communicate; it also transformed how they shop, travel, and learn. miniContext: To cut down on waste, the restaurant started looking for ways to **utilize** ingredients that used to be thrown away. Chefs learned to utilize vegetable scraps in soups and broths instead of the trash. Leftover bread was also put to use, with the kitchen finding clever ways to utilize it in desserts. Within a year, the restaurant had cut its food waste nearly in half simply by learning to utilize what it already had.

miniContext: Before publishing any story, good journalists **verify** every major fact with at least two independent sources. In this case, the reporter had to verify a claim that seemed almost too dramatic to be true. After days of calls, she was finally able to verify it with official records. Editors say that taking time to verify a story properly is always worth the delay.
